description: Audit findings for the latest complete run, grouped by check with severity, counts, sample item ids, and plain-English guidance on why each finding costs money and how to fix it. The audit measures the DELIVERED feed (after rules). Also returns `opportunities`: attributes left empty whose value was found in another field the merchant DID send (e.g. the brand sitting in the title, matched against brands the same feed already uses), each with exact fill and decline counts, the evidence, and a ready rule definition to pass straight to preview_rule. Opportunities are not defects: they sit outside totalIssues and the readiness score.
name: get_audit_findings
title: Get audit findings
